svg.text: 1 30 Jun: wakes, steppers and held autopilots begin (30 Jun–2 Jul)
2 10 Jul: DONE no longer held; AWAITING_EXTERNAL (10–11 Jul)
3 12 Jul: tier per dispatch; hook cap and re-fire; oplog
4 15 Jul: a wake per stepper beat (15–16 Jul)
9 13 Sept: wakes carry an issue id (log only)
10 17 Sept: passage Runner and legs live
11 25 Sept: legs skipped for approved plans; session cap
Weeks from 29 June; June before it has 10 logged changes. Sources: simple-dispatcher run logs and oplog, local transcripts, git, scorecard.
